add_rc_deps(iexplore.rc
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/iexplore.ico
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/iexplore.inf)

# iexplore.exe is all Rust (iexplore-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/iexplore-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# main.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/iexplore-rust/src/iexplore/main.rs)
# The resources are the one thing cmake still compiles, in this OBJECT library
# whose windres command the cargo link replays.
add_library(iexplore_res OBJECT iexplore.rc)
target_compile_definitions(iexplore_res PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
target_include_directories(iexplore_res PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
add_cargo_module(iexplore iexplore-cargo iexplore.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE iexplore-rust
    DESTINATION reactos
    DELAY_IMPORTS
    EXTRA_DEPENDS iexplore_res psdk)
